title: Tech Insights (demo fixture)

segments.speaker: Speaker_A
segments.text: Welcome back to Tech Insights. Today we're diving deep into why 99% of AI startups fail within their first six months.

segments.speaker: Speaker_B
segments.text: The truth is, most founders spend 90% of their time building wrappers around APIs without solving a core human pain point. When OpenAI updates a model, their entire business vanishes overnight.

segments.speaker: Speaker_A
segments.text: That is a terrifying reality. Can you share a concrete example of a company that actually built an unshakeable moat?

segments.speaker: Speaker_B
segments.text: Absolutely. Look at company X. Instead of focusing on raw text generation, they integrated directly into complex enterprise workflows. They built unique proprietary data flywheels that get smarter with every single user interaction. You cannot copy that with a single prompt.

segments.speaker: Speaker_A
segments.text: Wait, so what is the exact formula for a young developer listening right now who wants to build something enduring?

segments.speaker: Speaker_B
segments.text: Rule number one: Stop chasing shiny technology. Find a boring, painful, high-friction workflow in legal, healthcare, or logistics. Automate 80% of it, keep a human in the loop for the critical 20%, and sell outcome rather than software seats.

segments.speaker: Speaker_A
segments.text: That is incredible advice. People forget that utility always beats novelty in the long run.

segments.speaker: Speaker_B
segments.text: Precisely! Novelty lasts three weeks. Utility builds billion-dollar enterprise value that lasts decades.
